body:
Me and my friend j were sittin at his house thinking about wheather or not to eat the 7 grams of mushrooms he had. Well about an hour before the football game and we decided to eat them. At first we didnt feel shit but then after about 90 min. I was hit full force by these magic caps. Well I was wondering around because I did not know what the hell I was in. The football game looked like someone had cut every player coach ref and goal posts out of cardboard and placed them on the field.
Everyone seemed ot slide as if on ice not walking on cement. Well then a couple of peopl were fighting and I flipped in my head I almst started crying cuz I felt so bad about the fights. After wondering for about ten more minutes I found a ride home. The ride home was a trip in its self. I kept seeing a man with a third eye in the backseat when I looked in the side mirror, but when I turned around thier was no one there. This really messed with my head. But sitting in that car on the ride home I felt as if I knew what the meaning of life was. Not to mention I read the entire book 'The collective teachings of karl marx' no this book was wierd . But after I came down I realized that these little puppies could help you figure a lot of cool shit out.
